start.message: So you see, camp is in a sorry state right now, but soon enough we'll be ready to make another go of it. My men have already been moving your ship's cargo while you've been getting yourself acquainted.

about-anton.message: Don't let the laborious nature of his work fool you. Anton's wit is as sharp as the blades his forge produces.

about-creach.message: Creach is a former Swordfellow and military man through and through.

about-camille.message: If you've lost half the men that Camille's lost...
